design.objective: unrestricted minimax regret over bases, fixed mixtures, and finite response scenarios
design.selection: one fixed strategy covering new-cohort shares from zero through 60 percent
design.legacy_cases: retain prior search and final validation scenarios at the 15 percent cap
design.baseline_control: same unrestricted objective before adding the new cohort
design.fresh_legacy_checks: new peers and further responses at up to 15 percent, against a common current/selected pool
